description.p: A question asked before there is anything to lose.
An awareness greater than the situation requires.
Satisfaction pursued in the immediate, achieved, and not felt.
Deferred fulfilment: effort now, to be repaid elsewhere.
Faith in a future that will justify the present.
Labour whose point has gone, or a success that arrives without satisfaction.
The swing between pressure and flatness, which a change of circumstance will not stop.
A complaint addressed to a world that does not listen.
A question of closeness: how near to stand to others.
Living among the remains of something that has ended.
Lucidity without relief, to be endured and put to use.
Persistence in work without a promise of result.
Helping someone because they suffer, with no calculation of return.
Dignity in a precarious place, and joining with others in it.
A pause in the cycle of wanting.
The conclusion of a long argument, and the question of whether to follow it.
